value.answer: My pick is the Toyota Sienna. It gets 36 mpg combined and it's the only minivan sold only as a hybrid, and Edmunds has it ranked first. It's not a settled call though. The Honda Odyssey is the one that drives most like a car and has the biggest cargo number. If you want the lowest base price, the Kia Carnival starts at $36,990 and has a 10 year/100,000 mile powertrain warranty.
